decision: Worker wakeup and phase boundary overhead are too small to be the main optimization target. Focus on CPU matrix kernels, beginning with singleton gate/up calculations.
limitations: Active drain duration includes atomic task acquisition, matrix decoding/dot products, activation arithmetic and memory stalls. It is not a pure floating-point arithmetic measurement.
Per-phase longest worker time and total active span are parallel intervals and must not be summed as independent latency.
CPU placement and speculative acceptance vary across runs. This is a bottleneck measurement, not a demonstrated speed improvement.
